scheme_name: Travel Grant Scheme For College Teachers / College Librarians / Vice Chancellors / Commission Members And UGC Officers
occupation: Permanent Teacher of Institution of National Importance
other_conditions: Must be a permanent employee (teacher or librarian) of a college or institution covered under the scheme.
Must be enlisted under sections 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act where applicable.
UGC Officers must be at the level of EO/US or above.
Applicants must submit the application at least two months before the conference start date.
Incomplete applications will be rejected and no correspondence will be entertained.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance covering travel, registration fee, per diem, and visa fees, disbursed in a single installment after the conference.
